title: Multiplication and Division
summary: Arrays, multiplying bigger numbers, sharing equally and remainders.

cbse.chapter: Maths Mela (2025) Ch 6: The Dairy Farm

objectives: I can use arrays to multiply.
I can multiply by 1- and 2-digit numbers.
I can divide and understand remainders.
misconceptions: Multiplying always makes a number bigger, even by 0 or 1.
A remainder can be bigger than the divisor.
